description: Popular vegetable crop grown commercially and domestically.

diseases.name: Early Blight
diseases.description: Fungal disease causing dark concentric spots on leaves.
diseases.organic_treatment: Remove infected leaves and improve air circulation.
diseases.prevention_tips: Rotate crops and avoid overhead irrigation.

diseases.name: Late Blight
diseases.description: Aggressive disease affecting leaves, stems and fruits.
diseases.prevention_tips: Monitor humid weather and avoid excessive moisture.

diseases.name: Bacterial Wilt
diseases.description: Bacterial disease causing sudden wilting of plants.
diseases.prevention_tips: Use crop rotation and disease-free seedlings.
